κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also ὄφρά κε + subj., temporal: ’until’ (ὄφρά κε … ἔλθῃσι ’until … comes’)

μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν) · also ’and do not’ with an infinitive used as a command (μηδὲ … καλλείπειν ’and do not leave’) · also ’and not’ continuing a ὅπως clause with opt. (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν μηδὲ τρομεοίατο ’that they pass and not tremble’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μούλιον: Μούλιος — Mulius, an Epean warrior (son-in-law of Augeias); masc. acc. sg. · also another man of the name, killed by Patroclus; masc. acc. sg.
μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
μώνυχες: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed (with an undivided hoof); adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’)
νέκυάς: νέκυς — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. pl. (νέκυας), accented before the enclitic τε
νέρθεν: νέρθεν — from beneath, below, underneath; adv., epic (= ἔνερθεν)
νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
νηπύτιον: νηπύτιος — childish, like a child (= Attic νήπιος); masc. acc. sg., predicative, with ὣς: ’like a child’
νύξ: νύσσω — stab, pierce; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (νύξ’ = ἔνυξε) · also νύξ — night; fem. nom. sg. · also aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (νύξ’ = νύξε): ’stabbed’
ξίφει: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. sg., of means: ’with a sword’
ξίφεϊ: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ξίφει): ’with a sword’
ξίφος: ξίφος — sword; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., as subject (ξίφος ἄγη ’the sword was broken’)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὔατος: οὖς — ear; neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ὠτός)
οὔρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic οὔρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
οὖς: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. sg. (gen. ὠτός)
οὖτα: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, without augment: ’stabbed’
πάγη: πήγνυμι — fix, make fast; aor. 2 pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπάγη): ’was fixed, stuck’
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. · also + gen.: ’in front of’
πέσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἔπεσεν): ’fell’
πήληκι: πήληξ — helmet; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the helmet’
παλάσσετο: παλάσσω — spatter, besmear, defile; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐπαλάσσετο): ’was spattered’
παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔστην): ’standing beside’
πείραθ: πεῖραρ — end, limit, boundary; neut. acc. pl., elided (πείραθ’ = πείρατα; Attic πέρατα)
πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to obey, to be going to obey’
πεπάλακτο: παλάσσω — splash, spatter, besmear; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’was spattered’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πηλεΐδη: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. voc. sg., patronymic
πηλεΐδης: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
πνοιῇ: πνοιή — breath, blast, breeze; fem. dat. sg.
ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles · also Ποδάρκης — Podarces, son of Iphiclus, leader of the men of Phylace; masc. nom. sg., proper name
πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many, great; fem. dat. sg.: ’thick, great’
πολύδωρον: Πολύδωρος — Polydorus, youngest son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
πορφύρεος: πορφύρεος — purple, dark, dusky; masc. nom. sg., epithet of death
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
προΐει: προΐημι — send forth, send off; impf. 3 sg. (προΐει, diaeresis marking the separate syllable)
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’ · also adv., elided: ’in front, before him’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς before a following enclitic (οἱ): ’lest somehow’ · also accented before the enclitic με, softening a statement: ’somehow, rather’ (μάλα πώς με ’very much, somehow, me’)
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’ · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), attributive with a subject: ’the whole’ (πᾶν ξίφος ’the whole sword’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σκότος: σκότος — darkness; masc. nom. sg., the dark of death
σμερδαλέα: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated · also accented before the enclitic μοι (ὅ τέ μοι), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated · also accented before the enclitic με (ὅς τέ με), the epic particle of the relative clause, not translated
τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τέταρτον ’the fourth time’ · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
ταρβήσας: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with οὐ: ’unafraid’ · also without a negative: ’terrified’ (ταρβήσας χαλκόν ’terrified by the bronze’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶα: Τρώς — Tros, son of Erichthonius; masc. acc. sg. (Τρῶα)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’) · also neut. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸ μὲν … τὸ δέ: ’one thing … another’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τύψε: τύπτω — strike, stab; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἔτυψε): ’struck’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)
τῆλ: τῆλε (elided τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’ · also masc. acc. dual, in apposition to ἀνέρε: ’two sons’ (υἷε δύω Μέροπος)
φίλης: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. gen. sg.
φλογὶ: φλόξ — flame, blaze; fem. dat. sg., dat. of likeness: ’(like) flame’
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χαλκείῃ: χάλκειος — of bronze; adj., fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic χαλκῇ), agreeing with κνήστι
χαλκείῳ: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze-tipped; masc./neut. dat. sg.
χαλκός: χαλκός — bronze; masc. nom. sg., also the bronze blade or spear-head
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χείρων: Χείρων — Chiron, the wise centaur, healer and teacher; masc. nom. sg.
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. after διά: ’through the hand’ (διὰ χειρός)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀκόντων: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. gen. pl.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμπεπαλὼν: ἀναπάλλω — swing up, brandish; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, ἀμ- by assimilation of ἀνά
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’) · also masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’head-on, face to face’
ἀντιβολήσας: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having met’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. ὑπεθερμάνθη: ὑποθερμαίνω — warm from beneath, heat; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’grew warm’
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέε: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented and uncontracted (= ἔρρει)
ῥίμφά: ῥίμφα — lightly, swiftly; adv. (epic; Attic κούφως, ταχέως)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥαθάμιγγες: ῥάθαμιγξ — drop, splash; fem. nom. pl.
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
